'''Dan Bojanowski''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 95 from Springfield, Mo. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He studied Business Management at Evangel University in Springfield, Missouri.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/bojanowskidan.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Gold 95 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010112154000/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/bojanowskidan.html Internet Archive]</ref> He later appeared on [[Radio Free Decipher]] discussing Territorial Opens and LOTR organized play (broadcast 121 index).

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
